priorTurns.text: Teach me how a hash map handles collisions.

A hash map handles collisions when two keys produce the same bucket index. With separate chaining, each bucket stores a small collection, often a linked list or dynamic array, of the key-value pairs that landed there. Lookup hashes the key, goes to that bucket, then compares keys within the collection. This keeps insertion and lookup simple, though a long chain makes the bucket slower.
